 How Many Episodes Are In ‘MobLand’ Season 2? ‘MobLand’ Season 3 Info
 Decider Follow Josh Sorokach Add to Preferred Sources Thu, October 29, 2026 at 3:30 PM UTC 1 / 2 How Many Episodes Are In ‘MobLand’ Season 2? ‘MobLand’ Season 3 Info
 Things are heating up as we prepare for the final few episodes of MobLand Season 2.
 Dangerous new enemies — How incredible has Johnny Flynn been as Frankie? — and shifting alliances abound as the wild Harrigan family attempt to maintain their dominance.
 Advertisement Advertisement "Harry, I'm taking over," Kevin (Paddy Considine ) tells our favorite fixer in the midseason trailer. "And either you're with me, or you're against me."
 The battle between the Harrigans and the dangerous combination of Frankie and Kat McAllister (Janet McTeer) is about to reach its inevitable crescendo. When do new episodes of MobLand drop on Paramount+ ? How many episodes are left in Season 2? What's the story on MobLand Season 3?
 Here's everything you need to know.
 When Do New Episodes of MobLand Come Out?
 The next new episode of MobLand , Season 2, Episode 7 ("Ace of Spades"), premieres Friday, October 30 at 3:01 a.m. ET on Paramount+. 
 MobLand Season 2: How Many Episodes?
 The second season of MobLand consists of ten total episodes.
 MobLand Season 2 Episode Release Schedule:
 MobLand Season 2, Episode 8: Friday, November 6
 MobLand Season 2, Episode 9: Friday, November 13
 MobLand Season 2, Episode 10: Friday, November 20
 Will There Be a MobLand Season 3?
 You know it! Ahead of the second season premiere, Paramount+ renewed MobLand for a third season . Tom Hardy, Pierce Brosnan, and Helen Mirren are all set to return for "more bloody chaos."
 Where To Watch MobLand Season 2 For Free:
 MobLand streams exclusively on Paramount+ .
 Advertisement Advertisement Paramount+ offers two subscription plans, Essential and Premium. Right now, you can get started with a seven-day free trial on the Premium plan.
 The ad-supported Essential plan typically costs $8.99/month, while the ad-free Premium plan (which comes with Showtime titles and live CBS) costs $13.99/month.
 SUBSCRIBE TO PARAMOUNT+ 
 Does Paramount+ Offer a Free Trial?
 Yes! While Paramount+ doesn't directly offer a free trial, you can sample the streamer by adding Paramount+ to your Prime Video or Hulu accounts for an additional $13.99/month. You can also purchase Paramount+ through YouTube, which offers a free trial .
 MobLand Season 2, Episode 7 debuts Friday, October 30 at 3:01 a.m. ET on Paramount+.
